## Checklist

- [ ] Target branch is correct (feature/* -> develop, release/* and hotfix/* -> main)
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated, `npm test` passes
- [ ] `terraform fmt` / `validate` pass and the plan output is reviewed (infra changes)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or account IDs hardcoded
- [ ] Security scan findings resolved or justified below
- [ ] Docs / runbooks updated if behavior changed
